title: Charity's Theft and the Gunner's Reckoning
storySoFar: Vic Stone's Four Saddles empire dominates, but fractures widen. Silver Streak claws toward a title shot, masked and defiant against Stone's obsession with unmasking him. Colt Brady's blood war with Rex Creed escalates—Creed has now desecrated a charity collection tied to Brady's hometown, enraging the coal miner further. Hank Luther hunts Blackthorn Blake, who ambushed him backstage with his riding crop, busting him open. Jenny Crossfire battles Crystal Moon's psychological warfare and mystical fraud. Gunner Gates remains under suspicion as the mystery attacker; his cryptic denials and evasiveness plant growing doubt within the Four Saddles. A new player emerges: Blackjack Torres, a scarred drifter and gambler, has just arrived in the STW with his own hidden agenda. The Blue-Collar Brotherhood stands ready to fight back.

segments.title: Opening: The Charity Desecration

lines: The poor give, the Sermon takes—it's God's will!
Colt Brady, your charity is now MY collection plate!
Bow before the Sermon or lose everything!
Creed, you son of a bitch! That money was for my people!
I'm comin' for you at Steel & Scripture, and I'm takin' EVERYTHING!

beats.text: Colt Brady sees RED! The coal miner will NOT stand for such disrespect!
beats.speaker: pbp

segments.recap: Rex Creed brazenly desecrates a charity collection box tied to Colt Brady's hometown on live television, igniting Brady's fury and setting the stage for escalating bloodshed.

segments.title: Segment Two: The Television Champion's Warning

exchange.speaker: reverend_tate_chambers
exchange.text: Hank, Blake's been silent since he busted you open backstage. What's on your mind?

exchange.speaker: hank_luther
exchange.text: Blake thinks he's untouchable, but I know what he's run from. The reckoning's comin'.

exchange.speaker: reverend_tate_chambers
exchange.text: Are you saying you've identified him?

exchange.speaker: hank_luther
exchange.text: A man like that leaves a trail, Reverend. And I'm gonna follow it straight to justice.

segments.recap: Hank Luther warns Blackthorn Blake that his criminal past will catch up with him, foreshadowing their inevitable clash.

segments.title: Segment Three: Marcus Gray's Suspicion

exchange.speaker: marcus_gray
exchange.text: You've been evasive for weeks, Gunner. The Bombardier works alone—or does he?

exchange.speaker: gunner_gates
exchange.text: I don't know what you're talkin' about, Gray. The house always wins when you don't show your hand.

exchange.speaker: marcus_gray
exchange.text: That's not an answer. Vic's beginning to wonder where your loyalty lies.

exchange.speaker: gunner_gates
exchange.text: My loyalty? I've always played by my own rules, Mathematician. Maybe that scares you.

beats.text: The cracks in the Four Saddles are WIDENING! Gunner Gates has gone from ally to question mark!
beats.speaker: color

segments.recap: Marcus Gray publicly confronts Gunner Gates about the mystery attacks, demanding answers as the Four Saddles begin to splinter from internal paranoia.

segments.title: Segment Four: Main Event Tag Match – The Blue-Collar Brotherhood Tested

lines: The Bombardier's got a score to settle!

moments.speaker: colt_brady
moments.line: For my people, Blake! For the charity you THIEVES stole!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Brady and Luther working the arms—testing the heel side early!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: That Creed's got the endurance of a desert preacher; he won't break easy.

moments.speaker: hank_luther
moments.line: You're goin' DOWN, Blake! Justice finds all men!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Complete chaos! Gunner Gates and the Magnolia have turned this into a street fight!

segments.recap: Colt Brady and Hank Luther team to face Rex Creed and Blackthorn Blake, but Gunner Gates' interference causes a no-contest finish, further fracturing the Four Saddles and leaving Brady frustrated.

segments.title: Segment Five: The Mysterious Newcomer Arrives

lines: I'm Blackjack Torres, and I play for nobody but myself.
The house always wins when you don't show your hand.
In this Southern Territory, I'm collectin' old debts—and NEW ones.
By Steel & Scripture, everybody's gonna know the name TORRES.

beats.text: Who IS this Torres character? And what old scores is he here to settle?
beats.speaker: pbp

lines: Torres! You want to make waves in THIS territory? You answer to the people first!
The masked tradition stands against ALL predators!

exchange.speaker: silver_streak
exchange.text: This Southern Territory belongs to those who fight for the common man, not gamblers and drifters.

exchange.speaker: blackjack_torres
exchange.text: The masked man speaks? How noble. But masks hide cowards, Streak. I hide NOTHING.

exchange.speaker: silver_streak
exchange.text: Then let's find out what you're made of, Torres. At Steel & Scripture, I challenge you!

exchange.speaker: blackjack_torres
exchange.text: You're ON, Streak. Prepare to lose.

segments.recap: Blackjack Torres makes a stunning announcement in the ring: he's come to the STW to settle old scores, and he's got his eye on the Blue-Collar Brotherhood and the Four Saddles alike.

segments.title: Closing: The Gunner's Shadow

beats.text: Wait—is that Gunner Gates lurking by Stone's car? With his gear?!
beats.speaker: pbp

beats.line: Stone thinks he can buy loyalty. But the Bombardier answers to NO MAN.
